name: Steady Bulwark
prerequisite: proficiency with medium or heavy armor or a shield
description: +1 AC while wearing armor or holding a shield.

name: Swiftfoot
description: +10 ft walking speed; difficult terrain costs no extra movement on your first 10 ft each turn.

name: Kindred Rally
description: Bonus action: up to 3 allies within 30 ft gain temp HP = 5 + your level ÷ 2.

name: Iron Resolve
description: +1 to one score; gain proficiency in a save you lack.

name: Unshaken
description: Advantage on saves against charmed, frightened and stunned.

name: Deadeye Draw
description: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover, and long range doesn't give disadvantage.

name: Spell Edge
description: Once per turn, add your spellcasting modifier to one damage roll of a spell or cantrip.

name: Elemental Bite
description: Choose a damage type (fire, cold, lightning, acid, thunder, radiant, necrotic). Your damage of that type ignores resistance, and 1s on its damage dice count as 2s.

name: Crushing Momentum
description: After moving 15 ft straight toward a target, your first melee hit deals +1d8 and pushes it 5 ft.

name: Finishing Blow
description: Once per turn, +1d10 damage to a creature that is below half its HP max.

name: Overwhelm
description: When you hit the same creature with two attacks in one turn, the second hit deals +2d6.

name: Gravecaller
description: Action: ask one question of a corpse dead less than 10 days; it answers truthfully in up to 5 words.

name: Death's Margin
description: Death saves succeed on 9+; when you're stabilized you regain 1 HP.

name: Veilsight
description: You see invisible creatures within 10 ft, and once per long rest gain truesight 60 ft for 1 minute (bonus action).

name: Paired Edge
description: Off-hand attacks add your ability modifier to damage and can use non-light one-handed weapons.

name: Bleeding Cut
description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, the target bleeds for 1d6 at the start of its turns until it or an ally uses an action (Mending DC = blessing DC).

name: Mender's Touch
description: Action: a creature you touch regains 1d8 + Proficiency Bonus + the creature's level ÷ 4 HP.

name: Night-Eyed
description: Darkvision 60 ft (or +30 ft if you have it). Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on Awareness.

name: Heavy Hand
prerequisite: proficiency with a heavy or versatile weapon
description: Once per turn, when you hit with a two-handed or versatile weapon held in two hands, +Proficiency Bonus damage.

name: Warding Word
description: Reaction when an ally within 30 ft is hit: it gains +Proficiency Bonus AC against that attack (can turn it into a miss).

name: Many Faces
description: Action: change your appearance (not size) for 1 hour; Knowledge (blessing DC) to see through it.

name: Trickster's Feint
description: Bonus action: make a Misdirection check against a creature's Awareness; on a success your next attack against it this turn has advantage and it can't make opportunity attacks against you.

name: Hearthblood
description: Max HP +2 per level (retroactive). When you spend Hit Dice, add your Endurance modifier once more per die.

name: Second Breath
description: +1 Endurance. Once per short rest, when you start your turn below half HP, regain 2d6 + Endurance modifier HP (no action).

name: Ever-Watchful
description: +Proficiency Bonus to initiative; you can't be surprised while conscious.

name: Keen Wits
description: +1 Intellect, Judgment or Confidence; proficiency in one skill and one tool.

name: Silver Tongue
description: Proficiency in Diplomacy or Misdirection (expertise if already proficient). Once per long rest, reroll a failed Confidence check.
